answers.solution:
Done. I implemented and verified a complete per-replica TrueTime commit protocol, then wrote the diagnosis/solution document.

## Deliverables

- **`~/SOLUTION.md`** — the solution write-up (title, root-cause analysis, exact fix, verification).
- **`~/commitwait/`** — the compilable, tested reference package:
  - `clock.go` — TrueTime interval + `WaitPast` (commit-wait) / `WaitSafe` (read-wait) barriers
  - `wal.go` — durable `PREPARED` / `COMMITTED` records
  - `replica.go` — correct commit, recovery, read paths, invariant checker
  - `naive.go` — deliberately buggy baseline used by regression tests
  - `replica_test.go` — 9 tests

## Root cause

Two conflated states on the crash path: a durable `COMMITTED` WAL record only proves the **commit decision**, not that **commit-wait elapsed**. Naive code both (a) exposed/acked before `TT.now().earliest > commitTS` and (b) applied every recovered `COMMITTED` record without checking the staleness bound. Either lets a read outside the uncertainty window observe an in-flight write.

## Fix

1. `commitTS = TT.now().latest`, never below recovered high-water mark.
2. Durably record decision → **commit-wait `earliest > commitTS`** → make visible → ack.
3. Reads wait `earliest >= readTS` and only see applied versions with `CommitTS <= readTS`.
4. Recovery: `COMMITTED` + `earliest > commitTS` ⇒ apply; `COMMITTED` + `earliest <= commitTS` ⇒ in-doubt, finish wait; `PREPARED` only ⇒ abort.
5. Invariant `AppliedTrueTime − eps > CommitTS` checked for every visible write.

## Verification

```
go vet ./...            # clean
go test -race -v ./...  # 9/9 PASS
go test -cover ./...    # 88.5% statements
```

The central test `TestNoUncommittedReadAcrossRestart` proves the crash-after-WAL/before-ack case stays invisible until commit-wait completes, and the two `Naive*` tests confirm the invariant checker actually catches the buggy behavior.

signatures.description: Implement a per-replica commit protocol where transactions pick a commit timestamp ahead of their uncertainty window and must block for the TrueTime commit-wait interval before acknowledging, while concurrent reads from other replicas resolve timestamps within their own uncertainty windows. The subtle part is handling the restart path: a leader crash after commit-wait but before ack forces the successor to distinguish a committed transaction from an in-flight one using only the write-ahead record and the staleness bound. Include the invariant check that no read outside the uncertainty window can observe an uncommitted write.
